x: Butler, Ivan Mayers and Bob Wolton won the 1 mile medley relay, beating Mitcham, with Hercules third. Final points were:—Junior: Hercules A.C., 47; Belgrave H., 37; Mitcham A.C., 22.

We also had two races in the 440 yards Senior, and Bob Wolton won the first race, with "Jock" Cameron taking the second race. Wolton beat both Bob Taylor and Ian Badiali and is showing great improvement this season.
Ray Tooby won the 660 yards Senior, with Jim Heathfield in 2nd place, and Bob Wolton won the Senior 300 yards, with Ron Morrell in 4th place.

We also won the 1 miles medley relay, with Jim Heathfield, Bob Wolton, Ron Morrell and Ivan Mayers. In the Junior match we again triumphed, with 29 pts., with Shaftesbury H., 22 ; and Ealing and Maidenhead, 8 each.
In the final event, the 1 mile medley relay, our team of Bob Taylor, Bartlett, Holtum and Bob Wolton finished 3rd behind the Poly. and Achilles in 3 mins. 35 secs.

Kennedy (130) in third place, and although the scratch man, Jack Brown, started in the race, he retired after a couple of laps. We also had three heats in the 440 yds. handicap and the final saw Bob Wolton just beat C.
Marshall was also 3rd in the 220 yds., and Bob Wolton won the 440 in 53 secs., and was also 3rd in the 880 yds.

In the Senior events Ron Holtum won the 100 yds. and was 2nd in the 220, while Bob Wolton was 2nd in the 440 yds. Ian Badiali won the 880 yds. in 1 min. 59.1 secs., but nearly lost the race by easing at the tape, and Chas.

John Bromley won the 880 yds., and also finished 2nd in the 2 miles and so had a busy evening, and Bill Lucas was 4th in the latter event, with Len Bishop 2nd in the 880. Bob Wolton won the 440 yds., with "Jock" Cameron in 2nd place, and Percy Luxon won both the High and Long Jumps.

In the 1 mile medley relay our team of Jim Heathfield, Bob Wolton, Merrett and Key finished 4th, and so scored three points. It was in the field events that we scored best and our men are to be congratulated on their fine showing.
Alan Picton, making a reappearance, won the 220 yds. with Cornish second and Bob Wolton third. In the 440 yds. we saw Dicky Bartlett beat Bob Taylor, with Jim Heathfield in third place.

The 4 x 440 yds. saw only six teams competing and so this event was run as a final and we finished 5th, and at least our team of Bob Wolton, Jim Heathfield, Bob Taylor and " Jock " Cameron had the satisfaction of beating the Midland champions, Coventry Godiva H.
Cameron score a good win from Bob Wolton in 51.6 secs., with Ian Badiali in third place.

We also had first two in the 880 yds., and Jim Heathfield just "pipped" Bob Wolton for 1st place. Our team of Ian Badiali, Ron Morrell, Bob Wolton and " Jock " Cameron also won the 1 mile scratch relay in the good time of 3 mins. 36.8 secs.
Bob Wolton's 660 yards cannot be praised too much and the magnificent way in which the rest of the team rose to the occasion to give us a handsome win in the time of 3mins. 26.3secs was terrific.
Bob Wolton ran a creditable 6th in the 880 yards considering the small amount of training he has had owing to studies. The mile was the tit-bit of the afternoon.
